copy.tagline: 自动管理 Basecamp 项目、待办、消息和人员
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果日常用 Basecamp 管理项目，想自动化重复操作。
copy.tagline_en: Automate Basecamp projects, to-dos, messages, and people
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Basecamp daily and want to automate repetitive tasks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理 Basecamp 项目：创建待办清单和任务、发布消息、管理成员、用颜色分组整理待办事项。
howto.when: 当你要求操作 Basecamp 项目（如创建任务、发消息、加人）时触发。Claude 会先搜索可用工具，再执行对应步骤。

say.text: 帮我给项目「网站改版」创建一个待办清单，叫「首页优化」。
say.note: Claude 会查找项目并创建清单。

say.text: 在「首页优化」清单里加一个任务：更新导航栏，分配给张三。
say.note: Claude 会创建任务并分配负责人。

say.text: 在「网站改版」项目里发一条消息，标题是「本周进度」。
say.note: Claude 会发布消息到项目留言板。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Basecamp projects: create to-do lists and tasks, post messages, manage people, and organize to-dos with color-coded groups.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to operate on a Basecamp project (e.g., create tasks, post messages, add people). Claude first searches for available tools, then executes the steps.

say_en.text: Create a to-do list called 'Homepage Optimization' in project 'Website Redesign'.
say_en.note: Claude will find the project and create the list.

say_en.text: Add a task 'Update navigation bar' to the 'Homepage Optimization' list, assign to John.
say_en.note: Claude will create the task and assign it.

say_en.text: Post a message titled 'Weekly Progress' in the 'Website Redesign' project.
say_en.note: Claude will publish the message to the project board.
